我的生活与自然(My Life and nature): 一篇关于自然环境的A2短文:莉莉与杰克的经历和小计划。

Lily plays baseball with Jack every Wednesday. Lily thinks history is interesting but a little difficult. Lily learned a lot about history. For example, the castle was strategically placed on a hill above the river.
Lily usually has rice for breakfast. Lily wrote about the day in the diary. Lily is reading a book about history. Best of all, a butterfly landed on the red flower.
Lily hopes to visit Sydney one day. They took many photos at the river bank. Jack is interested in swimming. In fact, it often rains in April.
Lily and Jack had great fun there. Both of them like rice and coffee. Last Wednesday, Lily and Jack went to the bird-watching spot.
